title: Core as first built
notes: The Core set as the repository's first commit built it: 100 cards and 9 tokens.

title: Core Set balance changes
notes: The designer's balance changes (issue #1), whose notes landed first on 2026-09-20 (PR #2): #3 Right-house defender gains Taunt, #68 “Twisted Sourcerer” becomes “Twisted Sorcerer”, #81 Radiant Saintess changes twice, the Rush, Sheep and Felinor Tokens' Radiant faces grow, and the Bread Token gets a Radiant face of its own.

title: Call to Chaos and The Coin
notes: #95 Call to Chaos's text changes (PR #11), and The Coin is added for the player going second (PR #14).

title: The Radiant pass
notes: 99 entries change (PR #18). Every Radiant text is written out in full instead of in shorthand, Radiant stats and keywords are raised to one standard, #13 and #14 get the Jlockeed tag, and each card lists the cards its text names.

title: Patch v0.1.1
notes: The Ghoul Token is added and 105 entries change: card text is reworded (Deck and Tribute), Pierce arrives on #44 True Strike, #50 “Kpop Fanatic” becomes “K-Pop Fanatic”, #85 and #90 cost 2 instead of 1, #99 costs 4 instead of 3, #1, #8, #20 and #77 change their stats, #8, #55 and #81 lose keywords, #25, #56, #86 and #92 change their Radiant keywords, and #30, #50, #62 and #80 gain a tag.
